name: ship-fleet
description: Backlog-wide feature-delivery orchestrator. Surveys ALL remaining feature work in a product repo — LEDGER.md, docs/specs/spec-*.md, docs/plans/plan-*.md, untriaged briefs in docs/features-to-triage/, refined HTML mocks in design/mocks/html, deep research in docs/deep-research/ — reconciles any in-progress worktrees, then writes ORCHESTRATOR.md (a combined plan + ledger for everything left) and orchestrator-hierarchy.html (a visual dependency hierarchy) BEFORE any execution. It then drives the backlog to done by running the ship-feature skill per feature: dependency-ordered, up to 8 concurrent Opus runner agents, with mechanical plan-scoped coding optionally delegated to the Cursor CLI (composer-2.5) and verified/fixed by Opus, while the orchestrating session itself stays on the session model. Includes a preflight that checks the project's directory/file conventions (offering to clone diolog-team-files for CODING_PRACTICES.md / NEW_PROJECT_BEST_PRACTICES.md, gather stray feature briefs into docs/features-to-triage/, and validate the monolith layout against NEW_PROJECT_BEST_PRACTICES.md). Builds on the ship-feature plugin (and through it design-craft, feature-spec-pipeline, acceptance-e2e). Recalibrated for current-model behaviour (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 prompting guidance + the effort docs): the runner wire self-check no longer hardcodes a dated model id (a check pinned to last generation's string fires WRONG-MODEL on every correctly-routed runner and stops the fleet before it starts — it now names the TIER, so a newer Opus passes and a wrong tier fails); launch rule 2 gains the effort dial (an agent spawned with no effort runs at `high`, `low` is the level built for subagents, a feature runner is the long-horizon shape `xhigh` exists for — pair it with `max_tokens` ≥64k — and a review lane should drop effort before model, since REVIEWER ≥ WRITER is about capability class); the warm/cold resume boundary is corrected from a ~5-minute prompt-cache TTL to the harness's current 1-hour TTL (~5 minutes only in usage overage), with the instruction not to design a pause strategy around one TTL; and Operating discipline gains report-thinly plus ORCHESTRATOR.md-is-state-not-prose. Per-lane effort is canonical in feature-spec-pipeline/skills/work/references/model-and-effort.md.
